cond_0001.intro: As a Research Engineer - Combustion, you will be a member of a team focused on developing aircraft engine combustion technology and new technology relevant to advanced air-breathing propulsion systems. You will perform research and development of combustion technology and systems that will support [Company name masked].
cond_0001.responsibilities:
You will work in a team carrying out research and development of next generation combustion technology for low-emissions and sustainable aircraft engines and other high-speed air-breathing propulsion systems. In this role you will:
Work with technicians and engineers to design and install new experimental hardware; Perform high-pressure and temperature combustion experiments and analyze results; Work with other engineers in developing new combustion models and analysis tools; Lead cutting edge research in high-speed propulsion; Work in multidisciplinary teams to tackle the difficult challenges of hypersonic flight; Work as part of a team executing on multi-generation technology programs to enable future design advancements. Support/contribute to generation of intellectual property for [Company name masked]
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Doctorate in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or related disciplines OR Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or related disciplines with at least 5 years of relevant experience.
Knowledge of combustion, thermodynamics, fluid mechanics and combustion chemistry.
Background in planning, preparing, and performing combustion experiments or theoretical analysis.
Ability to investigate, model and provide critical insight into complex physical phenomena.
Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team.
Excellent communication skills and ability to interface with supporting functions, senior leaders, and customers with clarity and confidence.
Legal authorization to work in the [Location masked]. We will not sponsor individuals at the Masters level for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.
Preferred Requirements
Background in aircraft engine combustion and emissions, including: fuel/air premixing systems, autoignition, flame propagation in complex fuel mixtures, combustion kinetics & chemistry, thermo-acoustic instabilities (combustion dynamics), design and evaluation of new combustion systems, and modeling of combustion systems.
Peer reviewed journal publications.
Experience in establishing and working with high-pressure, high-temperature combustion experiments and facilities.

People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the underlying logic of combustion systems and the physical phenomena involved.
cond_0247.responsibilities:
You will work in a team carrying out research and development of next generation combustion technology for low-emissions and sustainable aircraft engines and other high-speed air-breathing propulsion systems. In this role you will:
Work with technicians and engineers to design and install new experimental hardware; Perform high-pressure and temperature combustion experiments and analyze results; Work with other engineers in developing new combustion models and analysis tools; Lead cutting edge research in high-speed propulsion; Work in multidisciplinary teams to tackle the difficult challenges of hypersonic flight; Work as part of a team executing on multi-generation technology programs to enable future design advancements. Support/contribute to generation of intellectual property for [Company name masked]
cond_0247.requirements: Doctorate in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or related disciplines OR Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or related disciplines with at least 5 years of relevant experience. Knowledge of combustion, thermodynamics, fluid mechanics and combustion chemistry. Background in planning, preparing, and performing combustion experiments or theoretical analysis. Ability to investigate, model and provide critical insight into complex physical phenomena. Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team. Excellent communication skills and ability to interface with supporting functions, senior leaders, and customers with clarity and confidence. Legal authorization to work in the [Location masked] is required. We will not sponsor individuals at the Masters level for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. Background in aircraft engine combustion and emissions, including: fuel/air premixing systems, autoignition, flame propagation in complex fuel mixtures, combustion kinetics & chemistry, thermo-acoustic instabilities (combustion dynamics), design and evaluation of new combustion systems, and modeling of combustion systems. Peer reviewed journal publications. Experience in establishing and working with high-pressure, high-temperature combustion experiments and facilities.

Ability to investigate, model and provide critical insight into complex physical phenomena

You will work alongside technicians and engineers to carry out research and development of next generation combustion technology for low-emissions and sustainable aircraft engines and other high-speed air-breathing propulsion systems. In this role you will:
Coordinate with technicians and engineers to design and install new experimental hardware; Conduct high-pressure and temperature combustion experiments and share analysis of results with the team; Work with other engineers in developing new combustion models and analysis tools; Collaborate on cutting edge research in high-speed propulsion; Work in multidisciplinary teams to tackle the difficult challenges of hypersonic flight; Work as part of a team executing on multi-generation technology programs to enable future design advancements; Support and contribute to generation of intellectual property for [Company name masked].
cond_0396.requirements: Doctorate in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or related disciplines OR Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or related disciplines with at least 5 years of relevant experience. Ability to investigate, model and provide critical insight into complex physical phenomena. Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team. Excellent communication skills and ability to interface with supporting functions, senior leaders, and customers with clarity and confidence. Legal authorization to work in the [Location masked] is required. We will not sponsor individuals at the Masters level for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. Background in aircraft engine combustion and emissions, including: fuel/air premixing systems, autoignition, flame propagation in complex fuel mixtures, combustion kinetics & chemistry, thermo-acoustic instabilities (combustion dynamics), design and evaluation of new combustion systems, and modeling of combustion systems. Peer reviewed journal publications. Experience in establishing and working with high-pressure, high-temperature combustion experiments and facilities.

cond_0599.intro: As a Research Engineer - Combustion, you will be a member of a team focused on developing aircraft engine combustion technology and new technology relevant to advanced air-breathing propulsion systems. cond_0599.responsibilities:
You will work in a team carrying out research and development of next generation combustion technology for low-emissions and sustainable aircraft engines and other high-speed air-breathing propulsion systems. In this role you will:
Work with technicians and engineers to design and install new experimental hardware; Perform high-pressure and temperature combustion experiments and analyze results; Work with other engineers in developing new combustion models and analysis tools; Lead cutting edge research in high-speed propulsion; Work in multidisciplinary teams to tackle the difficult challenges of hypersonic flight; Work as part of a team executing on multi-generation technology programs to enable future design advancements. cond_0599.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Doctorate in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or related disciplines OR Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or related disciplines with at least 5 years of relevant experience
Knowledge of combustion, thermodynamics, fluid mechanics and combustion chemistry
Background in planning, preparing, and performing combustion experiments or theoretical analysis
Ability to investigate, model and provide critical insight into complex physical phenomena
Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team
Excellent communication skills and ability to interface with supporting functions, senior leaders, and customers with clarity and confidence
Legal authorization to work in the [Location masked] is required. We will not sponsor individuals at the Masters level for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening
Preferred Requirements
Background in aircraft engine combustion and emissions, including: fuel/air premixing systems, autoignition, flame propagation in complex fuel mixtures, combustion kinetics & chemistry, thermo-acoustic instabilities (combustion dynamics), design and evaluation of new combustion systems, and modeling of combustion systems
Peer reviewed journal publications
Experience in establishing and working with high-pressure, high-temperature combustion experiments and facilities
